title: Repeat runs
subtitle: Repeat an evaluation or a comparison at set times, with a daily spending limit.
empty: No schedules yet. Add one below: pick a comparison file, a time and a daily spending limit.
noTicker: This server cannot start scheduled runs right now (it is offline). Saved checks start once it is back.
hostedLimits: Up to {{max}} repeat runs for this organization, {{count}} used. Each runs at most once every {{min}} minutes.
runNowAsk: Run {{name}} now? It starts {{evaluation}} again and can spend up to ${{left}} of this schedule's ${{limit}} limit.
runNowAskNoLimit: Run {{name}} now? It starts {{evaluation}} again. It spends model budget with no schedule limit.
removeAsk: Remove schedule {{name}}? It stops running. Past runs stay.
queued: Started (job {{id}}). Follow it in the jobs panel.

add.title: Add a repeat run
add.name: Name
add.evaluationHint: Each run starts a new evaluation with the same agent, benchmarks and gate. It needs a daily spending limit; an evaluation without its own budget gets the limit as its budget.
add.cron: When (cron: minute hour day month weekday)
add.hint: Example: 0 6 * * * runs every day at 06:00. Comparisons with a real model need a total budget (budget.total_usd) and a daily limit at least that large.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: A message is sent for every schedule when results get worse or a run fails. The address is not stored here: save it as a secret (Settings > Secrets) and pick its name.
alerts.noSecrets: No secrets yet. Add the alert address in Settings > Secrets first.

canary.name: Name
canary.agentsEmpty: No agents yet. Create one first.

whenOption.manual: Only when I press Check now

canary.cronCustom: Cron line (minute hour day month weekday)

whenWords.manual: It runs only when you press Check now.
whenWords.custom: It checks on the cron line {{cron}} ({{zone}}).

canary.smoke: Practice mode (a scripted model answers instead of your models: no model cost, and it cannot find real drift)
canary.force: Replace an existing drift monitor with this name
canary.created: Drift monitor {{name}} created. Next: record its baseline (the reference result later checks are compared with).
canary.createdWhen: Drift monitor {{name}} created. {{when}} Next: record its baseline (the reference result later checks are compared with).
canary.baselineConfirm: Record a new baseline for this drift monitor? This runs it once and can spend up to ${{usd}}.
canary.deleteConfirm: Delete drift monitor {{name}}? Its baseline and check history are deleted too.
canary.missing: To create the drift monitor, pick an agent, a benchmark, the tasks and at least one model, and set both spending limits (or tick Practice mode).

problem.name: Use lowercase letters, digits, - or _ for the name, at most 48 characters.
problem.tasks: Pick the tasks to check, or choose all tasks.
problem.targets: Add at least one model to watch.
problem.cron: Enter a cron line for the custom schedule.
problem.budget: Set both spending limits, or tick Practice mode.
problem.budgetOrder: The limit per check is above the limit per day, so no check could start.
problem.cronInvalid: Not a valid schedule. Example: 0 2 * * * is every day at 02:00.

canary.suitesEmpty: No benchmarks yet. Pick one from the catalog first.
canary.pausedNote: Paused: scheduled checks do not run until you resume. Check now still works.
canary.noSchedulePause: This drift monitor runs only when you press Check now, so there is nothing to pause.
canary.unknown: No drift monitor is called {{name}}. It may have been deleted.
canary.baselineConfirmNoCap: Record a new baseline for this drift monitor? This runs it once in practice mode: a scripted model answers, so there is no model cost.

noTickerAction: Set up a drift monitor instead
